description: Estimate the cost of an LLM/API workload (input + output tokens) for a usage-priced provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock…) from its real rate card.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens for the workload (e.g. per month). At least one of inputTokens/outputTokens must be > 0.

model.description: Model id as listed on the rate card, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5"; an unknown model returns the available list

outputTokens.description: Output tokens for the workload. At least one of inputTokens/outputTokens must be > 0.

slug.description: Usage-priced API product, e.g. "openai-api", "claude-api", "google-gemini-api", "amazon-bedrock" (vendor names like "anthropic" also resolve)

name: estimate_llm_cost
